decisions.reason: As a space-grade camera closely tied to the firm’s core optical and navigation business, it fits strong customer demand and the company’s strategy to extend proven mission-critical imaging products.
The modular navigation camera matches the firm’s push toward more flexible and adaptable spacecraft sensors and should be retained as a strategic evolution of its established offer.

A space situational awareness sensor suite builds directly on the firm’s sensor and observation capabilities and addresses an expanding need among spacecraft operators for reliable monitoring and navigation support.

The miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR sensor is well aligned with the firm’s stated move toward compact instruments for future spacecraft and smaller satellites, so it is worth continuing despite its earlier lower website prominence.
